about_blocks.text: Together We Can takes a unique approach to addiction treatment by using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. Their aim is to help individuals struggling with addiction find lasting recovery by creating an environment that fosters connection and support. This approach has been successful in helping many individuals conquer their addiction and live fulfilling, sober lives.

Their aim is to help individuals struggling with addiction find lasting recovery by creating an environment that fosters connection and support. This approach has been successful in helping many individuals conquer their addiction and live fulfilling, sober lives.

about_blocks.text: The Main Centre is the flagship program offered by Together We Can. Consisting of 5 residential homes, it provides clients with access to counseling and group spaces, as well as a fitness center. This program is grounded in the 12-Step approach, which has been shown to be effective in treating addiction. Other programs offered by Together We Can include Elevate, Solid Ground, Alliance, and All My Relations. Each of these programs has been designed with a specific goal in mind and uses different therapeutic approaches to help individuals in their recovery journey.

Fitness Programs

about_blocks.text: Health and wellness play a critical role in addiction recovery. Exercise has been shown to help reduce stress, increase dopamine levels, and promote overall well-being. To help clients achieve optimal wellness, Together We Can offers a fully equipped, state-of-the-art fitness center staffed with 2 personal trainers. Clients work closely with these fitness experts as well as dietitians to develop individualized plans that meet their specific needs.

about_blocks.text: Residential homes at Together We Can are strategically located away from the main campus to provide clients with a sense of independence and real-world living. Clients are encouraged to lead active lifestyles and are provided with a range of fitness options to choose from, including yoga, Pilates, and weight training. By incorporating exercise into their daily routine, clients at Together We Can are able to build healthy habits that contribute to their overall recovery.

Therapeutic Approaches

about_blocks.text: Together We Can understands that there is no one-size-fits-all approach to addiction treatment. This is why they offer a range of programs, each with its own unique therapeutic approach. The Main Centre, for example, is grounded in the 12-Step approach, which is based on the principles of Alcoholics Anonymous. This approach emphasizes the importance of surrender, acceptance, and personal responsibility in achieving sobriety.

about_blocks.text: Together We Can is a specialist in addiction treatment using evidence-based therapies and a community-based approach. The organization operates five residential programs to meet different needs; The Main Centre is its largest location, consisting of five homes, counseling and group spaces as well as an exercise facility – all following a 12-step recovery model.

The organization operates five residential programs to meet different needs; The Main Centre is its largest location, consisting of five homes, counseling and group spaces as well as an exercise facility – all following a 12-step recovery model.

about_blocks.text: Elevate is a private residential treatment home that offers care and therapy to individuals suffering from substance abuse issues, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), or trauma. The program utilizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical-behavioral therapy (DBT), as well as 12-step facilitation.

The program utilizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical-behavioral therapy (DBT), as well as 12-step facilitation.

about_blocks.text: Solid Ground is a non-12-step recovery program that utilizes narrative therapy, motivational interviewing (MI), and group activities. With its low staff-to-client ratio, the program emphasizes building relationships and trust – essential ingredients for long-lasting change.

faqs.question: Who is Together We Can - Addiction Recovery & Education Society?

answer_blocks.text: Established in Vancouver, Canada in 1993, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.
answer_blocks.html: Established in Vancouver, Canada in 1993, Together We Can is a non-profit organization that offers addiction treatment services and programs for those seeking recovery from substance use disorders.

faqs.question: What addiction treatment services does Together We Can provide?

answer_blocks.text: Together We Can provides a variety of addiction treatment solutions, such as residential treatment programs, outpatient programs and aftercare support systems. Their residential facilities include The Main Centre, Elevate, Solid Ground, The Alliance and All My Relations – each offering different treatment modalities and systems.
